items.content_html: A lightweight Chrome extension that removes account-identifying session cookies and custom headers from Google Search requests. It protects your search privacy while keeping you logged into other Google services (Gmail, YouTube, etc.) on other tabs. Includes Firefox User-Agent and NID cookie spoofing to bypass bot-detection captchas.
